papers.title: Agentic Retrieval for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: We introduce an agentic retrieval workflow for scientific discovery that combines iterative literature search, evidence tracking, and synthesis over daily arXiv updates.

papers.title: Benchmarking Multimodal Paper Assistants
papers.abstract: This paper benchmarks multimodal assistants for reading long scientific papers, focusing on citation grounding, figure understanding, and recommendation quality.
